layout.comment: This project predates av-swe's default layout and already holds 47 completed sprints. Two deviations from the skill defaults, kept deliberately so existing history stays valid:
layout.blockedFolder: present in new sprints only; sprints 001-047 predate it

gateNotes.perPackageBuild: npm run build:<pkg> (e.g. npm run build:web-client) — preferred inside a task; the full `build` gate runs at sprint end
gateNotes.focusedTest: npx vitest run <path> — preferred inside a task; the full `test` gate runs at sprint end
gateNotes.fmt: npx oxfmt <changed files> — scoped, never a project-wide reformat
